maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from selling cutting machines plus materials and accessories to crafters; mostly first-time machine sales and consumable materials, not repair.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumers and hobbyists buying craft machines, materials and subscriptions; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by launching its own machines, materials and tools and selling more; no acquisition pattern.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer hobby products; users could switch to other cutters, though Design Space software and material investment create modest lock-in.
